name: Bilal
self_text: I’m Bilal, a late‑20s German non‑binary enthusiast using a Sony camera. I’m looking for a practice session focused on specific shots, at a slow pace. No post‑processing lesson this time, and we’ll skip portraits of each other. I’m available Saturday afternoons and weekday evenings. I also love learning to sail in my spare time.

requests.request_text: I need you to be into a structured instruction session or a practice session working on specific shots, and I’d strongly prefer that you are okay with not taking portraits of each other, though that’s not a requirement.
